comment: No source is published; the maker's manual is at factionoptions.com/manual. The averaging loop walks 32 peer slots, counts a slot once if it is assigned and any of its four channel-active flags is set, adds all four of that slot's channels, and divides all four sums by that one count. So the divisor is per module, not per channel, which is a shade different from the manual's 'averaged from all peers with active CV'. The outputs are given no family: they carry whatever the collaborators patch.
